falsifiable_tests.name: message-command-style dead-option proof
falsifiable_tests.hypothesis: If any production code path set command_prompt:true, the ':' prompt would render quiet amber as documented and F3 would be wrong
falsifiable_tests.command: grep -rn command_prompt rmux/crates/rmux-server/src --include='*.rs' | grep -v test; sed -n '194,205p' handler_prompt.rs; sed -n '1,80p' handler_prompt/render.rs
falsifiable_tests.expected: at least one production constructor with command_prompt: true
falsifiable_tests.actual: sole production constructor handler_prompt.rs:203 sets command_prompt: false (explicit tmux-parity comment); render.rs:41,55,69 trues are all inside #[cfg(test)] mod tests -> option unreachable

falsifiable_tests.name: bell-on-active live reproduction
falsifiable_tests.hypothesis: If rmux never raised window_bell_flag on the active window, the F1 composite scenario would be unreachable
falsifiable_tests.command: scratch session: printf '\a' in current window of detached session; list-windows flags
falsifiable_tests.expected: bell flag can co-occur with active window

falsifiable_tests.name: activity dead-channel reproduction
falsifiable_tests.hypothesis: If monitor-activity were enabled anywhere in config/install, the styled activity state would be reachable and F2 wrong
falsifiable_tests.command: rmux show-options -gw | grep monitor; grep -rn monitor-activity config/ install.sh scripts/
falsifiable_tests.actual: monitor-activity off; no setter found; live no-render confirmed after output in unfocused window
